checks.name: raw_encoder
arguments: import json; from dataclasses import asdict; import numpy as np; import pandas as pd; from aura.config import AuraConfig; from aura.encoders.wav2vec2 import Wav2Vec2Encoder; from experiments.raw_pipeline import encode_recordings; cfg=AuraConfig.from_yaml('configs/experiment.v2.yaml'); encoder=Wav2Vec2Encoder(batch_size=16); assert encoder.info.revision == '0b5b8e868dd84f03fd87d01f9c4ff0f080fecfe8'; assert encoder.info.device == 'cuda'; rows=json.load(open('results/cost_confirmation_v7/inventory.json'))[:2]; x=encode_recordings(pd.DataFrame(rows),encoder,cfg.audio); assert x.shape == (2,768) and np.isfinite(x).all() and np.allclose(np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1),1,atol=1e-4); print(json.dumps(dict(encoder=asdict(encoder.info),shape=list(x.shape),norms=np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1).tolist()),indent=2))

scope: New isolated virtual environment on the same Windows machine; shared package-download cache, source, raw data and model cache. No retraining or new hardware replication.
